title: Chicken and Supreme Pizza
description: A delicious homemade pizza featuring chicken and supreme toppings. Perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Roll out the pizza dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet or pizza stone.
Brush the crust with light olive oil.
Spread the supreme pizza sauce over the crust, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Top the sauce with the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Add the sliced onions, bell peppers, and mushrooms.
If using pepperoni, add the slices on top of the vegetables.
Bake the pizza in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the pizza from the oven and sprinkle with oregano.
Let the pizza cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Cook the chicken separately in a pan over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through.
Slice the cooked chicken and add to the pizza before serving.
